question: Should OpenClaw accept Vault as a bundled plugin whose exec resolver receives Vault auth material and performs Vault network reads, or keep Vault as an external ClawHub/plugin package?
rationale: The code fits the existing SecretRef integration seam, but the bundled distribution and credential/network trust boundary require maintainer/security intent that automation cannot supply.

options.title: Accept bundled Vault after cleanup
options.body: Fix the docs and boundary failures, approve the dependency/security graph for the current head, and land the bundled plugin with the current SecretRef integration design.

options.title: Keep Vault external
options.body: Route the Vault provider to ClawHub or another external plugin package while keeping the current core SecretRef integration seam as the supported extension point.

options.title: Narrow to seam docs
options.body: Ask for a smaller follow-up documenting how external Vault plugins should use the existing integration contract without bundling resolver code.

recommendation.title: Accept bundled Vault after cleanup
recommendation.body: Fix the docs and boundary failures, approve the dependency/security graph for the current head, and land the bundled plugin with the current SecretRef integration design.

likelyOwner.reason: He has prior secrets-apply/security-adjacent history and was earlier assigned on this PR, while the unresolved blocker is the bundled credential resolver boundary.
